items.title: Partner request: batch inventory updates
items.author: account manager
items.body:
Forwarded from the partner's integration team (2026-09-10):

"Please send inventory updates in batches of at least 25 items per request (max 500). Single-item calls are hitting our rate limits. Stock still has to reach us within 15 minutes of a change, otherwise items show the wrong availability on our side."
